location_exception_reason: Prefabricated hospitals are engineered infrastructure products sold on structural capability, compliance, and modular design—not geographic origin. Location in titles adds no buyer decision value; it is a seller attribute, not a product attribute.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, EPC) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. The product is a prefabricated hospital building regardless of who manufactures or supplies it.
